policy.roster: Exact operational 2024–25 CCD LEA 1200390 / FL-13 attachments only; retain all 370 verified pure lower directory profiles.
policy.populations: Require complete reported pure PK–8 offerings, at least one offered grade 3–8, and explicit zero native Survey 2 enrollment in every grade 9–12. 365 profiles are offered-applicable; five primary-only profiles are nonapplicable.
policy.native_eligibility: Independent subject eligibility uses same-year raw individual lunch income and native Florida achievement exclusions; 357 eligible schools per subject. Preserve all source exclusions and ten native grade-school profiles with mixed CCD offerings outside the pure cohort.
policy.school_types: Retain exact attached-LEA charter, alternative and special-education flags. Missing native outcomes leave 261 noncharter and 96 charter regular schools eligible; no fit-driven exclusions.
policy.models: Separate 2024–25 native Florida full-year/home-zoned School Grades Math, ELA and Combined ES district OLS; never reuse statewide residuals.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use deleted-school residual scale with N−3 degrees of freedom.
policy.intervals: Point estimates only: native valid-score denominators are absent. Counts, sampling variances and all interval endpoints remain null, modelwide. An internal zero variance vector is a computational sentinel, never an uncertainty estimate.
policy.combined: Equally weighted mean of eligible Math and ELA proficiency; not percent proficient in both. No counts or sampling variance are inferred.
policy.release: Numerically verified audit only; approved_for_modeling remains false pending separate canonical and browser integration.

replay_tolerance.scope: Computed numerical metrics only. Source evidence, identity, configuration, membership, counts and interval absence compare exactly.

models.population: Exact attached-LEA pure grade schools with native same-year eligible income and achievement
models.subject: math
models.assessment: Florida School Grades FAST + FAA + Math EOC · grade schools
models.assessment_standard: 2024–25 native School Grades English Language Arts Achievement and Mathematics Achievement components: Level 3 or above / valid assessed students under Florida full-year-enrollment and home-zoned attribution rules, including eligible FAA Performance Task but excluding FAA Datafolio. ELA FAST PM3 grades 3–10 and Math FAST PM3 grades 3–8 plus B.E.S.T./Access Algebra 1/Geometry EOCs; this cohort enrolls no grades 9–12 in the same-year Survey 2 registry. ELL included after two US-school years; medical/extraordinary exemptions excluded. Components require at least 10 eligible students. Native whole-percent rates only; score denominators absent, so all model sampling intervals unavailable. Collocated combined results and provider-specific virtual rates are excluded from individual-school matches.
